tactical_description: Barcelona attempts to establish a structured build-up from the defensive line. They use short, lateral passes to draw out the Real Betis press before attempting a vertical entry into the midfield. Pedri (8) and Lamine Yamal (10), operating in more central roles, look to receive between the lines. The sequence is halted by a foul as the pressure from Betis intensifies in the central corridor.
key_tactical_insight: Central overloads are effective for ball retention but require higher tempo to disrupt a compact mid-block.
coach_actionable_advice: Encourage the pivot players to play one-touch into the attacking midfielders as soon as the opposition's front line is bypassed to prevent the block from resetting.
suggested_training_drill: 6v6 + 3 Neutral Rondo focusing on rapid vertical progression and playing through lines of pressure.

tactical_description: Barcelona shifts the focus to the wide channels, utilizing Balde (3) and Kounde to provide width. They attempt to penetrate the penalty area with a low cross following a series of drives and lateral shifts. The Betis defense maintains a tight 4-4-2 shape, successfully tackling and clearing the ball to prevent a direct shot on target.
key_tactical_insight: Over-reliance on wide crosses against a numerically superior box presence reduces efficiency.
coach_actionable_advice: Instruct wide players to use 'cut-backs' to the edge of the box rather than aerial crosses to exploit the space vacated by the retreating defensive line.
suggested_training_drill: 3v2 Wide Overlap and Cross: emphasizing cut-back delivery zones and late runs into the box.

tactical_description: Real Betis exploits a defensive lapse during a Barcelona transition. Antony (7) receives the ball in a pocket of space as the Barcelona backline is disorganized. Kounde is caught out of position, failing to track the diagonal run. A quick shot results in a goal, highlighting a failure in Barcelona's rest-defense structure.
key_tactical_insight: Inadequate cover in the 'rest-defense' phase allows the opponent to exploit half-spaces during turnovers.
coach_actionable_advice: Fix the positioning of the full-back opposite to the attack; they must tuck in to form a back three during possession to provide better cover against counter-attacks.
suggested_training_drill: Shadow Play for Rest-Defense: 8v5 possession game where the defensive team must reorganize into a 3-2 structure immediately upon loss of ball.

tactical_description: Barcelona delivers a high corner into the six-yard box. The initial header is contested, and the second ball falls to Marcus Rashford (14). He attempts a snap-shot which is blocked/saved. The phase ends with a Betis clearance, but demonstrates Barcelona's threat on the second phase of set-pieces.
key_tactical_insight: Winning the 'second ball' inside the box is as critical as the initial delivery in dead-ball situations.
coach_actionable_advice: Assign specific 'zonal crashers' whose sole responsibility is to attack the anticipated drop zone of the second ball rather than the primary delivery point.
suggested_training_drill: Set-Piece Scramble: Repeat corner deliveries where strikers must score within two touches after the initial defensive header.
